sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Support Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Status ailment resistance boosted by 30 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Wind and Time Defense from Unison Damage +500
